scope: cache-state, Roofline, and cross-target performance evidence for a fixed J/lowering-state search

identity_rule.cross_regime_rule: warm, streaming, and cold-data are separate estimands and must never be pooled
identity_rule.cross_target_rule: RTX 5090D, H100, and RVV are reported independently before any cross-target narrative
identity_rule.publication_primary_regime: cold-data denotes post-warmup, L2-controlled single-shot timing; process/module/JIT cold start is excluded
identity_rule.pre_measurement_stabilization_rule: before any cold-data timed samples, execute every compared prepared thunk outside the timed interval for the same declared time budget in round-robin order; this stabilizes code, pages, context, and device P-state but does not define the timed data-cache state
identity_rule.full_corpus_rule: every frozen production-catalog J remains an explicit matrix row for every target and experiment arm; not_matched, literal_shape_only, unavailable baseline, compile failure, and Q/D failure are retained rather than omitted
identity_rule.valuation_identity_rule: every result binds the unchanged j_digest plus the exact J-declared symbolic extent valuation and workload profile; a backend profile may not replace a J literal with a symbol

warm.definition: persistent tensor addresses and repeated prepared launches after code/data warmup
warm.publication_role: debugging or deployment-specific appendix; not the primary all-kernel aggregate

streaming.definition: rotate disjoint replicas of the exact certified invocation
streaming.minimum_working_set_rule: working set must be strictly larger than detected last-level data cache
streaming.preparation_rule: allocation, replication, and pointer binding are outside the timed interval
streaming.claim: address-rotating cache-pressure latency; not a DRAM-transaction measurement

cold-data.definition: evict target data cache before every single-shot measured invocation
cold-data.stabilization_rule: perform declared untimed code/P-state warmup before candidate ranking and again round-robin across the final Source/target pair before confirmation
cold-data.minimum_eviction_rule: eviction working set must be strictly larger than detected LLC/L2
cold-data.preparation_rule: eviction and synchronization are outside the timed interval
cold-data.claim: post-warmup L2/LLC-controlled data-cache state; process/module/JIT cold start is excluded

roofline.workload_numerator: floating-point operations derived deterministically from the materialized J
roofline.workload_denominator: certified boundary input plus output payload bytes
roofline.logical_traffic_rule: logical boundary bytes are a minimum traffic model, not measured DRAM transactions
roofline.memory_ceiling: target-side sustained copy benchmark counting one read plus one write
roofline.fp32_ceiling: target-side FP32 matrix multiplication with TF32 disabled
roofline.hardware_counter_rule: when available, measured DRAM/L2 counters are reported separately from logical traffic
roofline.memory_wall_claim_rule: a low arithmetic intensity is insufficient; the complete J cost must contain no unmodeled special-function throughput, observed latency must be between 0.95x and 2.0x of the logical Roofline lower bound, and large-shape/cache evidence must exclude fixed-latency domination
roofline.faster_than_roof_rule: latency below 0.95x of the calibrated logical Roofline lower bound indicates cache reuse or a traffic/ceiling mismatch and forbids a DRAM memory-wall claim
roofline.roof_distance_rule: latency above 2.0x of the logical Roofline lower bound is not roof-approaching and forbids a memory-wall claim
roofline.tiny_workload_rule: if observed latency exceeds the logical Roofline lower bound by more than 10x, classify as latency_or_unmodeled_work_dominated and forbid a memory-wall claim

search_ablation.e2: fixed structural and numeric trace with schedule search
search_ablation.e3: hard-safe structural/numeric lowering-state expansion with independent schedule search
search_ablation.c_pairing: C-prior and Erase-C traverse the same candidate universe under equal distinct-state/failure budget
search_ablation.retile_pairing: retiled and no-retile states use the same J, target lowerer, correctness policy, timer, and data regime
search_ablation.candidate_correctness: every measured executable candidate must pass Target-RefJ under the frozen Q/D search policy

required: unchanged J digest plus exact symbolic extent valuation and workload profile
an explicit status for every production-catalog J in every requested target/arm/profile matrix
forbidden: calling a named low-intensity operator memory-bound without measured-scale evidence
mixing warm CUDA-graph latency with cold single-shot latency in one aggregate
using warm-cache latency as the primary all-kernel publication aggregate
treating logical boundary bytes as hardware DRAM transactions
using TF32 as an explanation for a J with no typed contraction
reporting only accelerated or transformation-matched kernels while omitting the remaining production catalog
